correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly defines all open neighborhoods and establishes a necessary and sufficient total-domination criterion: each column contains a selected edge-vertex, both rows are nonempty, and a singleton row must be supported by the opposite paired edge-vertex or by its hub/peripheral vertex. At n>=3, simultaneous singleton rows are impossible. The three disjoint counting categories exhaust all edge selections, and binomial algebra yields the stated formula. The minimum coefficient and Bernoulli law are deduced symbolically. A standalone checker independently enumerated all 1,198,080 subsets for n=3,4,5,6 and confirmed every coefficient, but finite tests do not prove the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: Directly relevant full-text sources determine either the scalar total domination number on biclique middle graphs (2022), or the full polynomial for star/pendant-derived middle graphs (2017); neither supplies the full polynomial for the leaf-free two-row biclique middle graph. The generic 2016 reduction identities do not state the explicit family formula. Indexed mathematical record and web searches for equivalent exact expressions yielded no covering statement. This is a best-evidence priority assessment rather than a proof of uniqueness or independent priority certification.
residual_risks: Unindexed, renamed or inaccessible work could contain the same family enumeration.
General recurrence algorithms can compute graph polynomials in principle; the originality claim is about the explicit formula and its derivation, not independence from generic algorithms.
No external independent priority assessment has been obtained.

value.rationale: The 2022 published literature supplies the scalar optimum for middle graphs of complete bipartite graphs, creating a natural motivated gap: the structure and number of feasible sets of every size. The new exact polynomial resolves this for the non-pendant two-row biclique family, including all optimal multiplicities and the critical Bernoulli selection window with nondegenerate limit e^{-lambda^2}. These are not consequences of only the published scalar minimum. The result is an all-cardinality structural enumeration, not an arbitrary finite slice or nominal parameter renaming.
